```{python}
#| label: setup
import os
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import pins
import requests
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

DATA360_URL = "https://data360api.worldbank.org/data360/data"
COUNTRIES_URL = "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country"
PAGE_SIZE = 1000
START_YEAR = 2000

# Data360 indicator ID -> (short code, label, unit)
INDICATORS = {
    "WB_WDI_EG_ELC_ACCS_ZS": ("elec_access", "Access to electricity", "% of population"),
    "WB_WDI_EG_ELC_ACCS_RU_ZS": ("elec_access_rural", "Access to electricity, rural", "% of rural population"),
    "WB_WDI_EG_ELC_ACCS_UR_ZS": ("elec_access_urban", "Access to electricity, urban", "% of urban population"),
    "WB_WDI_EG_FEC_RNEW_ZS": ("renewable_share", "Renewable energy consumption", "% of total final energy consumption"),
    "WB_WDI_NY_GDP_PCAP_CD": ("gdp_pc", "GDP per capita", "current US$"),
    "WB_WDI_SP_POP_TOTL": ("population", "Population", "people"),
}

# The seven WDI regions and the world total; other aggregates are dropped.
REGIONS = {
    "SSF": "Sub-Saharan Africa",
    "SAS": "South Asia",
    "EAS": "East Asia & Pacific",
    "LCN": "Latin America & Caribbean",
    "MEA": "Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan",
    "ECS": "Europe & Central Asia",
    "NAC": "North America",
}
WORLD = {"WLD": "World"}


def http_session() -> requests.Session:
    retry = Retry(total=5, backoff_factor=1, status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504])
    session = requests.Session()
    session.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))
    return session


def energy_board():
    """Pin board and pin name: Connect when running there, a local folder otherwise."""
    name = os.getenv("ENERGY_PIN", "energy_indicators")
    if os.getenv("CONNECT_SERVER") and os.getenv("CONNECT_API_KEY"):
        board = pins.board_connect()
        if "/" not in name:
            name = f"{board.user_name}/{name}"
        return board, name
    local_dir = Path(os.getenv("ENERGY_PINS_DIR", Path.cwd().parent / "_pins"))
    local_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return pins.board_folder(str(local_dir)), name.split("/")[-1]


session = http_session()
```

```{python}
#| label: fetch
def fetch_areas() -> pd.DataFrame:
    resp = session.get(COUNTRIES_URL, params={"format": "json", "per_page": 400}, timeout=60)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    rows = []
    for c in resp.json()[1]:
        region = c["region"]["value"].strip()
        if region == "Aggregates":
            continue
        rows.append({
            "iso3": c["id"],
            "name": c["name"],
            "area_type": "country",
            "region": region,
            "income_group": c["incomeLevel"]["value"],
        })
    rows += [{"iso3": k, "name": v, "area_type": "region", "region": v, "income_group": None}
             for k, v in REGIONS.items()]
    rows += [{"iso3": k, "name": v, "area_type": "world", "region": v, "income_group": None}
             for k, v in WORLD.items()]
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def fetch_indicator(indicator_id: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Page through one Data360 indicator until every observation is retrieved."""
    values, skip, total = [], 0, None
    while total is None or skip < total:
        resp = session.get(
            DATA360_URL,
            params={"DATABASE_ID": "WB_WDI", "INDICATOR": indicator_id, "skip": skip},
            timeout=60,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json()
        total = payload["count"]
        values += payload["value"]
        skip += PAGE_SIZE
    df = pd.DataFrame(values)[["REF_AREA", "TIME_PERIOD", "OBS_VALUE"]]
    df.columns = ["iso3", "year", "value"]
    df["indicator_id"] = indicator_id
    return df


areas = fetch_areas()
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
    raw = pd.concat(pool.map(fetch_indicator, INDICATORS), ignore_index=True)

meta = pd.DataFrame(
    [(k, *v) for k, v in INDICATORS.items()],
    columns=["indicator_id", "indicator", "indicator_label", "unit"],
)

obs = (
    raw.assign(
        year=pd.to_numeric(raw["year"], errors="coerce"),
        value=pd.to_numeric(raw["value"], errors="coerce"),
    )
    .dropna(subset=["year", "value"])
    .astype({"year": int})
    .query("year >= @START_YEAR")
    .merge(meta, on="indicator_id")
    .drop(columns="indicator_id")
)
```

```{python}
#| label: checks
# Hold back isolated spikes in percentage indicators: a jump of more than
# MAX_JUMP points within three years that is not sustained the next year.
MAX_JUMP = 30

pct = obs[obs["unit"].str.startswith("%")].sort_values(["iso3", "indicator", "year"])
by_series = pct.groupby(["iso3", "indicator"])
prev_value, prev_year = by_series["value"].shift(1), by_series["year"].shift(1)
next_value = by_series["value"].shift(-1)

is_spike = (
    ((pct["value"] - prev_value).abs() > MAX_JUMP)
    & ((pct["year"] - prev_year) <= 3)
    & (next_value.isna() | ((next_value - pct["value"]).abs() > MAX_JUMP))
)
held_back = pct[is_spike].assign(previous_value=prev_value[is_spike])
obs = obs.drop(index=held_back.index)
```

```{python}
#| label: derive
# People without electricity = population x (100 - access) / 100
wide = obs.pivot_table(index=["iso3", "year"], columns="indicator", values="value").reset_index()
no_elec = (
    wide.dropna(subset=["population", "elec_access"])
    .assign(value=lambda d: d["population"] * (100 - d["elec_access"]) / 100)
    [["iso3", "year", "value"]]
    .assign(
        indicator="pop_no_elec",
        indicator_label="People without electricity",
        unit="people",
    )
)

energy = (
    pd.concat([obs, no_elec], ignore_index=True)
    .merge(areas, on="iso3", how="inner")
    [["iso3", "name", "area_type", "region", "income_group",
      "indicator", "indicator_label", "unit", "year", "value"]]
    .sort_values(["indicator", "iso3", "year"], ignore_index=True)
)

if energy.empty:
    raise RuntimeError("The Data360 API returned no usable observations.")
```

```{python}
#| label: write-pin
refreshed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
latest_years = energy.groupby("indicator")["year"].max().to_dict()

n_countries = int((areas["area_type"] == "country").sum())

board, pin_name = energy_board()
board.pin_write(
    energy,
    pin_name,
    type="parquet",
    title="Energy access indicators",
    description=(
        "Access to electricity, renewable energy share, GDP per capita, and population "
        f"for {n_countries} economies, "
        "seven regions, and the world, from the Data360 API."
    ),
    metadata={
        "source": "Data360 API, database WB_WDI",
        "refreshed_at": refreshed_at.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "start_year": START_YEAR,
        "latest_years": {k: int(v) for k, v in latest_years.items()},
    },
)
```

```{python}
#| label: summary
ssa_latest = (
    energy.query("iso3 == 'SSF' and indicator == 'pop_no_elec'")
    .sort_values("year")
    .tail(1)
)
headline = ""
if not ssa_latest.empty:
    people = ssa_latest["value"].iloc[0] / 1e6
    year = ssa_latest["year"].iloc[0]
    headline = (
        f"In {year}, about **{people:,.0f} million people** in Sub-Saharan Africa "
        "lived without access to electricity."
    )

display(Markdown(
    f"Refreshed **{refreshed_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} UTC**. "
    f"Wrote **{len(energy):,} rows** to the pin `{pin_name}`.\n\n{headline}"
))
```

## What this run retrieved

```{python}
#| label: coverage
coverage = (
    energy.groupby(["indicator_label", "unit"])
    .agg(
        areas=("iso3", "nunique"),
        first_year=("year", "min"),
        latest_year=("year", "max"),
        rows=("value", "size"),
    )
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={
        "indicator_label": "Indicator",
        "unit": "Unit",
        "areas": "Countries and regions",
        "first_year": "First year",
        "latest_year": "Latest year",
        "rows": "Observations",
    })
)
coverage.style.hide(axis="index").format({"Observations": "{:,}"})
```

## Data checks

```{python}
#| label: held-back
if held_back.empty:
    display(Markdown("No values were held back in this run."))
else:
    display(Markdown(
        f"{len(held_back)} value(s) were held back because they jump by more than "
        f"{MAX_JUMP} percentage points from the previous observation without being sustained:"
    ))
    display(
        held_back.merge(areas[["iso3", "name"]], on="iso3")
        [["name", "indicator_label", "year", "previous_value", "value"]]
        .rename(columns={
            "name": "Area",
            "indicator_label": "Indicator",
            "year": "Year",
            "previous_value": "Previous value",
            "value": "Reported value",
        })
        .style.hide(axis="index")
        .format({"Previous value": "{:.1f}", "Reported value": "{:.1f}"})
    )
```

Every app in this showcase reads the pin this document writes, so none of them calls the Data360 API directly.
